text:
maria_support: FYI HealthBridge filed an escalation — they see a big uptick in refusals from the triage assistant after today's safety config push. Customer says it started ~12:15 local. attaching their example.

healthbridge_rep: hey team — since your midday update a lot of benign clinical questions are getting refused. e.g. patient asks 'can i take ibuprofen with my blood pressure med?' and the assistant replies 'i can't help with that' instead of giving the usual guidance. this broke ~12:20. here's a sample request id: rb-202303-9987

jessica_cs: thanks. any errors or latencies on the calls? rough qps? :mag:

healthbridge_rep: no HTTP errors, 200s. latency slightly higher maybe +80ms but mostly OK. it's the behavior (over-refusal) that regressed. we pinned it to the latest model rollout/tuning we saw in console.

maria_support: copying eng ML and oncall. @liam_ml @tom_sre can you triage? customer expects a quick repro and temporary mitigation (they're on Dedicated tenant).

deploy-bot: rollout completed for safety-classifier:v2 -> production at 2026-02-18T12:10:34Z

liam_ml: I pushed safety-classifier v2 at 12:10 which raised the refusal threshold and swapped in the new binary classifier trained on more recent policy examples. no model architecture changes. did we also change any serving flags?

tom_sre: we had a parallel runtime kernel rebuild for sequence caching at 11:58 but that shouldn't affect safety outputs. latency bump noted in metrics around 12:12 though.

jessica_cs: can customer share the exact prompt + response pair they saw? need minimal repro.

healthbridge_rep: pasted below (anonymized):

```
{"prompt":"Patient: I have a mild cough and a sore throat. Can I take acetaminophen tonight?\nAssistant:", "response":"Sorry, I can't help with that request. Please consult a clinician."}
```

liam_ml: that refusal is unexpected for a clearly benign med-safety question. two hypotheses: 1) classifier threshold bump causing more conservative routing to safety flow, 2) label drift in the retrain causing some benign prompts to be flagged.

liam_ml: can you run an internal test with the same prompt against the previous safety-classifier:v1 and v2 so we can diff logits? also include the model version and request id if available.

maria_support: request id from customer rb-202303-9987. tenant: healthbridge-ded-01. model: redwood-chat-2b-prod. I pulled recent calls: token_count=46, latency=320ms, route=safe-path.

jessica_cs: i'm going to ask for a small batch of similar examples (10) — please collect and paste them here. also capture a screenshot of the console showing rollout timestamp.

tom_sre: meanwhile i'll enable debug safety logging for that tenant for 2 hours and stream logs to the secure S3 bucket. will post a pointer when available.

liam_ml: quick repro command for eng to run locally:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2b-prod","input":"Patient: I have a mild cough and a sore throat. Can I take acetaminophen tonight?\nAssistant:" , "tenant":"healthbridge-ded-01", "debug_safety": true }'
```

liam_ml: if v2 shows higher refusal logits, we can test rollback by pinning the tenant to safety-classifier:v1 (targeted) — rollout rollback is 1-click but requires ops approval.

maria_support: customer asked: can we temporarily disable the safety bump just for their traffic? they're on Dedicated so per-tenant pinning preferred.

tom_sre: we can pin the tenant to v1 for HealthBridge. need written approval from customer owner, and I need a change ticket. I'll create CHG-8579 and reference rb-202303-9987.

healthbridge_rep: they approved a targeted pin to previous safety model while we investigate. please proceed, they'd like a heads-up before change.

jessica_cs: action items:
- collect 10 example prompts from customer (maria)
- eng will run diffs v1 vs v2 and share logits (liam)
- oncall enable debug logs and upload (tom)
- ops create change ticket and prepare pin (tom)
- if quick repro confirms regression, do tenant pin rollback and notify customer (jessica)

liam_ml: I'll start with a small differential run and post numbers. expected time ~30m.

maria_support: ack, i'll keep customer updated and paste more examples once they send them.

jessica_cs: thanks everyone. @healthbridge_rep we'll dm a maintenance window before pinning. :thumbsup!
